description: Windows notch and dock with media controls, quick settings, system status, and desktop productivity features.
notes: Verified with 7-Zip 26.05: the official NSIS package extracts bloom.exe at the payload root. Scoop uses #/dl.7z and does not run the vendor setup routine.
The NSIS payload also contains $TEMP/MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe. Scoop does not execute this bootstrapper; Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime must already be present or be installed separately.
Upstream first-run code enables Bloom autostart when it is not already enabled. This creates Windows startup integration on first launch; the manifest leaves this application behavior unchanged.
